item.title: San Jose's PayPal Park to host LA28 Olympic soccer matches
item.description: The Bay Area will now be in on the action for the 2028 Olympics in Los Angeles with the announcement that PayPal Park in San Jose will host some early-round soccer matches for both the men and women.
